text_en: Agrippa said to Paul, “You have permission to speak for yourself. ” Then Paul stretched out his hand and began to defend himself:
text_cn: 阿格黎帕向保禄说：“准你为自己辩护。”那时，保禄便伸起手来，辩护说：

text_en: “I consider myself fortunate that it is before you, King Agrippa, I am to make my defense today against all the accusations of the Jews,
text_cn: “阿格黎帕王！我今天能在你跟前，对于犹太人所控告我的一切事，得以辩护，我觉得十分幸运，

text_en: because you are especially familiar with all the customs and controversies of the Jews; therefore I beg of you to listen to me patiently.
text_cn: 尤其你熟悉犹太人的一切习俗和争端，所以我求你忍耐听我。

text_en: “All the Jews know my way of life from my youth, a life spent from the beginning among my own people and in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 我自幼年以来，从起初在我民族中，以及在耶路撒冷，处世为人如何，犹太人都知道。

text_en: They have known for a long time, if they are willing to testify, that I have belonged to the strictest sect of our religion and lived as a Pharisee.
text_cn: 假如他们肯作证的话，他们从很早就知道：我是按照我们教中最严格的宗派，度着法利塞人的生活。

text_en: And now I stand here on trial on account of my hope in the promise made by God to our ancestors,
text_cn: 现在，我因希望天主对我们祖先的恩许，而站在这里受审。

text_en: a promise that our twelve tribes hope to attain, as they earnestly worship day and night. It is for this hope, your Excellency, that I am accused by Jews!
text_cn: 我们十二支派，日夜勤恳地事奉天主，希望这许诺到来。王啊！正是为了这个希望，我为犹太人所控告。

text_en: Why is it thought incredible by any of you that God raises the dead?
text_cn: 天主既使死人复活了，为什么你们竟断为不可信呢？

text_en: “Indeed, I myself was convinced that I ought to do many things against the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
text_cn: 本来，我本人过去也认为，应尽力反对纳匝肋人耶稣的名，

text_en: And that is what I did in Jerusalem; with authority received from the chief priests, I not only locked up many of the saints in prison, but I also cast my vote against them when they were being condemned to death.
text_cn: 我在耶路撒冷就这样作过。我不但从司祭长那里取得权柄，把许多圣者关在监里；而且他们被杀时，我还投了票。

text_en: By punishing them often in all the synagogues I tried to force them to blaspheme; and since I was so furiously enraged at them, I pursued them even to foreign cities.
text_cn: 我也曾在各会堂里，多次用刑，强迫他们说亵渎的话；而且分外狂怒地迫害他们，直到外邦的城市。

text_en: “With this in mind, I was traveling to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests,
text_cn: 在这期间，我曾取得司祭长的权柄和准许，往大马士革去。

text_en: when at midday along the road, your Excellency, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and my companions.
text_cn: 王啊！时当正午，我在路上看见一道光，比太阳还亮，从天上环照着我，和与我同行的人；

text_en: When we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It hurts you to kick against the goads. ’
text_cn: 我们都跌倒在地。我听见有声音用希伯来话向我说：‘扫禄，扫禄，你为什么迫害我？向刺锥踢去，为你是难堪的。’

text_en: I asked, ‘Who are you, Lord? ’ The Lord answered, ‘I am Jesus whom you are persecuting.
text_cn: 我说：‘主！你是谁？’主说：‘我就是你所迫害的耶稣。

text_en: But get up and stand on your feet; for I have appeared to you for this purpose, to appoint you to serve and testify to the things in which you have seen me and to those in which I will appear to you.
text_cn: 但是，你起来，站好，因为我显现给你，正是为了要选派你为我服务，并为你见到我的事，以及我将要显现给你的事作证。

text_en: I will rescue you from your people and from the Gentiles—to whom I am sending you
text_cn: 我把你从这百姓及外邦人中救出，是要打发你到他们那里去，

text_en: to open their eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those who are sanctified by faith in me. ’
text_cn: 开明他们的眼，叫他们从黑暗中转入光明，由撒殚权下归向天主，好使他们因信我而获得罪赦，并在圣化的人中得有分子。’

text_en: “After that, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,
text_cn: 因此，阿格黎帕！我对这天上的异像并没有失信，

text_en: but declared first to those in Damascus, then in Jerusalem and throughout the countryside of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God and do deeds consistent with repentance.
text_cn: 相反地，我首先向大马士革和耶路撒冷以及犹太全境的人，然后向外邦人传报，叫他们悔改，归向天主，作与悔改相称的作为。

text_en: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.
text_cn: 正是为了这个缘故，犹太人在殿里把我拿住，想要向我下毒手；

text_en: To this day I have had help from God, and so I stand here, testifying to both small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would take place:
text_cn: 但我得蒙天主的助佑，直到今天我还站得住，向卑微和尊高的人作证。我所讲的，不外乎先知和梅瑟所说过的，必将成就的事：

text_en: that the Messiah must suffer, and that, by being the first to rise from the dead, he would proclaim light both to our people and to the Gentiles. ”
text_cn: 就是默西亚怎样必须受难，怎样必须由死者中作复活起来的第一人，将光明传布给这百姓及外邦人。”

text_en: While he was making this defense, Festus exclaimed, “You are out of your mind, Paul! Too much learning is driving you insane! ”
text_cn: 保禄辩护到这里，斐斯托大声说：“保禄，你疯了！学问太多把你弄疯了。”

text_en: But Paul said, “I am not out of my mind, most excellent Festus, but I am speaking the sober truth.
text_cn: 保禄却说：“斐斯托大人！我没有疯，相反，我说的是真理和清醒的话。

text_en: Indeed the king knows about these things, and to him I speak freely; for I am certain that none of these things has escaped his notice, for this was not done in a corner.
text_cn: 因为王知道这些事，我便向他放心讲论。我深信这些事没有一件瞒得过他的，因为这不是在偏僻角落里行的。

text_en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe. ”
text_cn: 阿格黎帕王！你信先知吗？我知道你信。”

text_en: Agrippa said to Paul, “Are you so quickly persuading me to become a Christian? ”
text_cn: 阿格黎帕向保禄说：“你差一点就劝服我作了基督徒！”

text_en: Paul replied, “Whether quickly or not, I pray to God that not only you but also all who are listening to me today might become such as I am—except for these chains. ”
text_cn: 保禄说：“差一点也罢！差的多也罢！我总祈望天主，不但叫你，而且也叫今天听我的众人，除了这些锁链以外，都要像我一样。”

text_en: Then the king got up, and with him the governor and Bernice and those who had been seated with them;
text_cn: 于是王、总督和贝勒尼切，以及和他们同坐的人都起来，

text_en: and as they were leaving, they said to one another, “This man is doing nothing to deserve death or imprisonment. ”
text_cn: 退到一边，彼此谈论说：“这人并没有作过什么该死，或该监禁的事。”

text_en: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man could have been set free if he had not appealed to the emperor. ”
text_cn: 阿格黎帕对斐斯托说：“这人若没有向凯撒上诉，早就可以释放了。”
